about.heading: Crafting modern web experiences
about.intro: I'm an Applied Informatics student with 4 years of commercial development experience, now building across the full stack. I specialize in React 19 applications backed by Node.js APIs — with production deployments integrating OAuth flows, LLM APIs, and containerized microservices. Vue.js and WordPress remain active tools from years of client work.
about.description: I develop web solutions for diverse clients - from startups to established companies. My work combines modern design with clean code and a focus on user experience.

services.title: React 19 Full-Stack Development
services.description: End-to-end SPA development with React 19, TypeScript, and Node.js/Express backends. OAuth integrations, REST API design, Zustand/TanStack Query state architecture, and deployments across Vercel + Railway with Docker.

services.title: Vue.js SPA & WordPress Development
services.description: Production Vue 3 applications with Composition API, TypeScript, and Pinia — plus custom WordPress themes with SCSS build pipelines, GSAP animations, and performance optimization for commercial clients.

services.title: API & AI Integrations
services.description: Third-party API integration including Spotify OAuth 2.0 and Google Gemini with structured schema prompting. Experience designing gateway-proxied microservice architectures in Docker Compose with JWT and OAuth authentication strategies.

results.projects: successfully delivered projects of varying complexity
results.experience: years of real-world experience with commercial projects

about.resultsDescription: Improved load times by implementing lazy loading and code splitting. Created reusable component libraries reducing development time. Modern workflow with AI tools, with emphasis on code understanding.
about.currentlyDescription: I'm open to junior or medior frontend and full-stack roles where I can contribute with production-level React and Node.js experience while continuing to grow. Remote, hybrid, and on-site positions considered.

items.title: Lyra — Spotify AI Library Organizer
items.description: A full-stack app that authenticates with Spotify, ingests up to 5,000 saved tracks, and uses Google Gemini to generate playlist suggestions by genre, mood, and activity. Users review, edit, and push playlists directly back to Spotify.

items.title: Personal Blog / CMS
items.description: A TypeScript monorepo blog platform with authenticated authoring, comment threads, tag organization, image upload with media picker, and a custom Three.js WebGL animated background. 21 REST endpoints backed by PostgreSQL via Prisma.

items.title: Microservice Logger
items.description: A 5-service Docker Compose logging platform with a Sails.js API gateway proxying to FeathersJS microservices backed by MongoDB. Schema-driven data layer with JWT + OAuth auth strategies and sensitive field masking in gateway middleware.

items.title: UCM Connect — University Platform
items.description: Lead frontend developer on a Reddit-inspired community platform for the University of St. Cyril and Methodius. Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia state management, PrimeVue components, REST API integration, and Figma UI design.

contact.heading: Let's work together
